_comment: Task-DoD walking-skeleton hook manifest (issue #11 / ADR-0001). NOT merged into the live completion-harness/hooks.json by install.sh or anything else. It exists so the headless trial (tests/test-dod-headless.sh) can build a MERGED temp bundle — live hooks.json + these entries — for `claude -p --plugin-dir`, since the headless child loads hooks from one plugin dir and a skeleton in dod/ is otherwise invisible to it. Wiring the skeleton live is a separate, informed decision (issue: 'Not wired live').
